title: Gluing of cotorsion pairs via recollements of abelian categories
summary: Let $( \mathcal{A^{'}},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{A^{''}},i^\ast,i_\ast,i^!,j_!,j^\ast,j_\ast)$ be a recollement of abelian categories. Suppose that we are given two cotorsion pairs $({\mathcal{U^{'}}},\mathcal{V{'}})$ and $({\mathcal{U}^{''}},{\mathcal{V}^{''}})$ in $\mathcal{A}^{'}$ and $\mathcal{A}^{''}$, respectively. We construct two cotorsion pairs $(^{\bot}{\mathcal{N}_{\mathcal{V^{''}}}^{\mathcal{V^{'}}}},\mathcal{N}_{\mathcal{V^{''}}}^{\mathcal{V^{'}}})$ and $(\mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U^{''}}}^{\mathcal{U^{'}}}, ({\mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U^{''}}}^{\mathcal{U^{'}}}})^\bot)$ in $\mathcal{A}$.…
